# Alchemforge Software

> Alchemforge Inc (Spring Valley, NY) builds privacy-first software: a Windows desktop app and browser extensions for Chrome and Microsoft Edge. Everything runs locally on the user's computer - nothing is uploaded. One-time prices, free tiers, no subscriptions.

## Products

- Offline Bank Statement Converter (Windows): PDF bank statements to CSV/XLSX/QBO, 100% offline, every row verified against the statement's printed balances. $129 one-time. https://alchemforge.com/converter.html | Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P2DT3RD35FG | FAQ: https://software.alchemforge.com/bank-statement-converter.html
- Save All Tabs as PDF (Chrome + Edge): all open tabs to one searchable PDF. Free up to 5 tabs, Pro $12 one-time. Chrome: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/fpooocajkgfageliiledpmeejcghopeg | Edge: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/ahoblpcdangokhojinmcjpdlcibbicci
- FileCheck - Rule 5.2 Pre-Filing Audit (Chrome + Edge): flags unredacted identifiers in court filings locally. $79 one-time. https://software.alchemforge.com/filecheck.html
- Pact Blocker (Edge): website blocker with partner lock. $14.99 one-time. https://software.alchemforge.com/pact-blocker.html
- Invoice Namer (Edge): renames invoice PDFs from their contents, locally. $39 one-time. https://software.alchemforge.com/invoice-namer.html
- Merge PDF Locally (Edge): combine PDFs in the browser, no upload. $19 one-time. https://software.alchemforge.com/merge-pdf.html
- Blur & Mark (Edge): screenshot, annotate, blur before sharing. $19 one-time or $7/year. https://software.alchemforge.com/blur-and-mark.html
- Blind Sendout (Edge): blind resume versions for recruiters. $49 one-time. https://software.alchemforge.com/blind-sendout.html
- EOB Match (Edge): checks medical bills against EOBs, builds dispute kit. $29 one-time. https://software.alchemforge.com/eob-match.html
